title: Remimazolam and Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting in High-risk Patients
brief_summary: This trial aims to explore whether the intraoperative use of remimazolam can reduce the incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) in high-risk patients. According to the Apfel's simplified score, patients with 3 or more of the following factors are at high risk of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), i.e., women, non-smokers, history of PONV, and postoperative use of opioids.
